This is SFCC-91 Step 2 of 4: a new atom, `ZimmColourSwatch`, was just built. Test it and report findings — you never fix anything.

FILES IN THIS STEP (read them all in full before testing):
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` (new — the Chakra recipe)
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx` (new — the component)

- `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (edited — should be exactly a 2-line diff: one new import, one new key)

Run `git status --porcelain` and `git diff -- overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` yourself to confirm the edit's actual size — do not trust this description.

## What this component is supposed to do

A single PDP colour swatch: a 48×72px clickable rectangle showing that colour variation's product photo, with radio semantics (`role="radio"`, `aria-checked`), rendered as a react-router `Link` when a destination URL exists (so selecting a colour updates the URL without a full page reload — this is the AC 4 mechanism) or a plain non-interactive `<span>` when no URL exists (the quick-view-modal path). Three visual states distinguished by the recipe: Unselected (background only), Selected (adds a bottom-only border, NOT a full box border — verify this is genuinely bottom-only in the actual recipe code, not assumed), Focus (adds a CSS `outline`/`outlineOffset` via `_focusVisible`, independent of selected).

Design values were pulled directly from Figma for this exact component (nodes 40000307:13826/13831, 40002689:3839, all `Large/Rectangle`) — background `#f6f4f1` = `ivory[200]` = `var(--zimm-color-background-02)`; border/focus colour `#191919` = `grey[900]` = `var(--zimm-color-border-focus)`; the focus ring mirrors an existing pattern already in this codebase, `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmNavItem/zimmNavItem.css.ts` (read it to compare). Deliberately, this component does NOT replicate base SFCC's `backgroundColor={name.toLowerCase()}` behaviour (visible in `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx`'s `renderDefaultVariationAttribute`, or the base package) — the claimed reasoning is in the component's own code comment; verify it's coherent, not just present.

## What to actually test (fan out your own angles, but cover these)

- Run `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` yourself — reproduce, don't trust a report. Known baselines on this branch BEFORE this step: tsc 0 errors; test 26 files/408 tests (Step 1 added no test file); lint 20 problems/4 errors (pre-existing, at `overrides/app/routes.tsx:23,24` and `overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts:116,335` — neither touched by this step)/16 warnings, exit 1; audit:tokens exactly 4 unacknowledged (in header/ and navConstants.ts, none in this step's files)/22 acknowledged, exit 1.
- Confirm `recipeParts.test.ts` (at `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts`) actually ran and passed a case specifically for this new recipe — search the test output for the recipe's name, don't just check the overall suite passed.
- **A specific, real gap to independently verify, not take on faith:** read `overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` yourself and find its `DEFAULT_STYLE_PROPS`/`PROP_COMBINATIONS` construction (search for those identifiers). Confirm directly whether `selected` is or is not one of the boolean keys that harness varies. If it is NOT (which is what a prior check found), this means that automated guard's fuzzing walk NEVER actually exercises this new recipe's `selected: true` branch (the bottom-border code) — every one of its ~32 generated prop combinations would call this recipe's `baseStyle` with `selected: undefined` (falsy), so the guard only ever sees the unselected branch. Confirm this yourself by reading the actual test file, not by trusting this description. If confirmed, this is a real testing-infrastructure gap (pre-existing, this step is just the first recipe to actually be affected by it, since it's the first recipe with a `selected`-keyed branch) — report it clearly, but do NOT treat it as a reason this component's OWN code is wrong; separately confirm by direct manual read whether the actual `selected: true` branch in `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` is itself token-clean (all `var(--zimm-*)`, no raw values) despite the automated guard not walking it.

Would the `Default`/`Selected` stories (which presumably pass an `href`) actually render without throwing, given that requirement? Read the file to confirm, don't assume it's there because it was supposed to be.

Independently re-run that exact mutation yourself: temporarily reintroduce a `backgroundColor={name.toLowerCase()}`-equivalent value into the component or recipe, re-run just that one test, confirm it actually fails, then revert and confirm it passes again. Report your own before/after output — do not just cite the implementer's.
- Check whether the "colour renders above size" ordering concern, or any Step 3/Step 4 concern, leaks into this step's files (it shouldn't — this atom takes no opinion on ordering, that's the molecule's and the page's job). Flag if it does.

## What to check against the accessibility rules this codebase enforces

`.coderabbit/ast-grep-rules/` mechanically enforces: every `IconButton` needs `aria-label` (not applicable here, no IconButton used) — but also check generally: is there anything here that isn't a native interactive element but carries an `onClick`-like affordance without a `role`/keyboard handling? 1	import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
2	
3	/**
4	 * Recipe for a single PDP colour swatch — a clickable rectangle filled with that colour
5	 * variation's product photo. Two parts: `swatch` is the outer clickable box (geometry,
6	 * background, border, focus ring); `image` is the element carrying the dynamic
7	 * background-image fill — the URL itself cannot live here, see the component's own comment on
8	 * why that one `__css` spread stays dynamic.
9	 *
10	 * Values below are read directly off Figma for the three states this recipe distinguishes, not
11	 * estimated from surrounding metadata — Unselected (node 40000307:13826), Selected
12	 * (40000307:13831), Focus (40002689:3839), all under `size=Large/Rectangle`.
13	 */
14	export const ZimmColourSwatch = {
15	  parts: ['swatch', 'image'],
16	
17	  baseStyle: ({ selected }: { selected?: boolean }): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({
18	    swatch: {
19	      display: 'inline-block',
20	      cursor: 'pointer',
21	      // Figma's Rectangle width (48px). Height (72px) has no direct token — the named scale has
22	      // nothing between 64px and 140px — so it's expressed as an aspect ratio on the width
23	      // instead. 2:3, not the incidentally different ratio Figma's raw code-gen attached to the
24	      // placeholder product photo pasted into that frame instance: the Selected-state node
25	      // carries its own dev annotation reading "Image aspect ratio - 2:3", which is the number
26	      // to trust here.
27	      width: 'var(--zimm-scale-1200)',
28	      aspectRatio: '2 / 3',
29	      // Identical across Unselected/Selected/Focus — ivory[200] / background['02'] in
30	      // theme/foundation/colour.ts.
31	      backgroundColor: 'var(--zimm-color-background-02)',
32	      // Selected: a bottom-only border — the raw Figma export is unambiguous, a `border-b`
33	      // utility rather than a full box border. Colour is grey[900] / border.focus, the only
34	      // alias-tier value that resolves to it (border.default and border.secondary are both
35	      // light greys and never appear anywhere in this design).
36	      ...(selected
37	        ? {
38	            borderBottomWidth: 'var(--zimm-border-width-default)',
39	            borderBottomStyle: 'solid',
40	            borderBottomColor: 'var(--zimm-color-border-focus)',
41	          }
42	        : {}),
43	      // Focus: Figma draws this as the Selected baseline plus a ring at slightly asymmetric
44	      // per-side offsets, same colour. Not replicated literally — there is no other precedent
45	      // anywhere in this codebase for a non-uniform ring, and the asymmetry reads as that one
46	      // frame instance's export noise rather than a deliberate design decision. Mirrors
47	      // zimmNavItem.css.ts's own focus-ring block instead: a uniform `outline` + `outlineOffset`
48	      // pair, applied independently of `selected` above — a swatch can be focused without being
49	      // selected, and selected without being focused. `--zimm-focus-ring` already composites the
50	      // same border-width/colour pair used above; `--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default` matches
51	      // three of Figma's four side offsets.
52	      _focusVisible: {
53	        outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)',
54	        outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
55	      },
56	    },
57	    image: {
58	      display: 'block',
59	      width: '100%',
60	      height: '100%',
61	      backgroundSize: 'cover',
62	      backgroundPosition: 'center',
63	      backgroundRepeat: 'no-repeat',
64	    },
65	  }),
66	};

1	import { defineStyleConfig } from '@chakra-ui/react';
2	
3	// Vertical leading around the label. Figma's footer-item allows equal space above and
4	// below the text and lets the item height follow the line count — 24px for one line,
5	// 38px for two (node 40000407:11736 > About Section > Links). Its text boxes are
6	// cap-height (8px one line, 22px two) where a browser line box is not, so the rule
7	// transfers rather than the numbers. The inner span reserves 1px for the underline
8	// indicator, so a line box measures 15px and two measure 29px; 4.5px each side yields
9	// 15+9=24 and 29+9=38 exactly. No 4.5px entry exists in spacing.ts — same provisional
10	// treatment as zimmButton.css.ts's BTN_PADDING_Y, pending UI-designer sign-off.
11	const NAV_ITEM_PAD_Y = '4.5px';
12	
13	const baseStyle = {
14	  // textStyle is expanded in place by Chakra's style engine; fontFamily below
15	  // deliberately overrides it — Figma Default/Navigation binds brand/font/family/body,
16	  // not the heading family textStyles.navigation carries.
17	  textStyle: 'navigation',
18	  fontFamily: 'var(--zimm-font-family-body)',
19	  display: 'inline-flex',
20	  // Figma h-[24px] is a FLOOR, not a fixed height — the design's own ABOUT column
21	  // wraps "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF COUNTRY" onto two lines. minHeight keeps the 24px
22	  // target while letting multi-line labels grow, so no caller needs to override it.
23	  minHeight: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)', // 1.5rem (24px) — Figma: h-[24px]
24	  // Height comes from lineHeight + padding, not from centring inside minHeight.
25	  // Centring only distributes space a single line leaves over, so a wrapped label
26	  // overflowed the floor and lost its leading entirely — the second line of
27	  // "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF COUNTRY" sat flush against the item above it.
28	  lineHeight: 'var(--zimm-font-lineheight-4xs)', // 0.875rem (14px)
29	  paddingBlock: NAV_ITEM_PAD_Y,
30	  justifyContent: 'center',
31	  alignItems: 'center',
32	  whiteSpace: 'normal',
33	  cursor: 'pointer',
34	  background: 'none',
35	  border: 'none',
36	  // paddingInline, not the `padding` shorthand: a shorthand here would sit after
37	  // paddingBlock above and reset it back to 0.
38	  paddingInline: 0,
39	  textDecoration: 'none',
40	  // Inner span carries the underline. Use transparent instead of 'none' so
41	  // border-color transitions smoothly on hover/active without a display change.
42	  '& > span': {
43	    borderBottom: 'var(--zimm-border-width-default) solid transparent',
44	    transition: `border-color var(--zimm-motion-duration-fast) var(--zimm-motion-easing-standard)`,
45	  },
46	  _hover: {
47	    '& > span': { borderBottomColor: 'currentColor' },
48	  },
49	  // Active (aria-current="page"): permanent underline regardless of hover
50	  '&[aria-current="page"] > span': {
51	    borderBottomColor: 'currentColor',
52	  },
53	};
54	
55	const variants = {
56	  light: {
57	    color: 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)',
58	    _focusVisible: {
59	      outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)',
60	      outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
61	      boxShadow: 'none',
62	    },
63	  },
64	  inverse: {
65	    color: 'var(--zimm-color-text-inverse)',
66	    _focusVisible: {
67	      outline: 'var(--zimm-border-width-default) solid var(--zimm-color-text-inverse)',
68	      outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
69	      boxShadow: 'none',
70	    },
71	  },
72	};
73	
74	export const ZimmNavItem = defineStyleConfig({
75	  baseStyle,
76	  variants,
77	  defaultProps: { variant: 'light' },
78	});

// All --zimm-* variables, derived from the other foundation/* files (the actual source
// of truth, ported from the Figma-to-React work) rather than retyped here. Injected onto
// :root by _app-config/index.tsx via <Global> from @emotion/react, so the .zimm-* classes
// in globalStyles.ts can resolve their var(--zimm-*) references.
import { FONT_MEDIUM, FONT_REGULAR, FONT_SERIF } from './fonts';
import { colors } from './colour';
import { fontSizes, lineHeights, letterSpacings, fontWeights } from './typography';
import { spacing, borderWidths, focusRingOffsets } from './spacing';
import { iconSizes, actionSizes } from './sizes';
import { grid } from './gridSystem';
import { motion } from './motion';

export const zimmTokens: Record<string, string> = {
  // ---- Brand / Primitive: Greys ----
  '--zimm-color-grey-black': colors.grey.black,
  '--zimm-color-grey-900': colors.grey[900],
  '--zimm-color-grey-800': colors.grey[800],
  '--zimm-color-grey-700': colors.grey[700],
  '--zimm-color-grey-600': colors.grey[600],
  '--zimm-color-grey-500': colors.grey[500],
  '--zimm-color-grey-300': colors.grey[300],
  '--zimm-color-grey-200': colors.grey[200],
  '--zimm-color-grey-100': colors.grey[100],
  '--zimm-color-grey-white': colors.grey.white,

  // ---- Brand / Primitive: Ivory ----
  '--zimm-color-ivory-400': colors.ivory[400],
  '--zimm-color-ivory-300': colors.ivory[300],
  '--zimm-color-ivory-200': colors.ivory[200],
  '--zimm-color-ivory-100': colors.ivory[100],

  // ---- Brand / Primitive: Status ----
  '--zimm-color-coral-500': colors.coral[500],
  '--zimm-color-green-500': colors.green[500],
  '--zimm-color-orange-500': colors.orange[500],
  '--zimm-color-red-500': colors.red[500],

  // ---- Brand / Primitive: Opacity (base: grey/900) ----
  '--zimm-color-opacity-50': colors.opacity[50],
  '--zimm-color-opacity-40': colors.opacity[40],
  '--zimm-color-opacity-30': colors.opacity[30],
  '--zimm-color-opacity-15': colors.opacity[15],

  // ---- Alias / Semantic: Text ----
  '--zimm-color-text-default': colors.text.default,
  '--zimm-color-text-inverse': colors.text.inverse,
  '--zimm-color-text-inverse-grey': colors.text.inverseGrey,
  '--zimm-color-text-secondary': colors.text.secondary,
  '--zimm-color-text-muted': colors.text.muted,

  // ---- Alias / Semantic: Background ----
  '--zimm-color-bg-01': colors.background['01'],
  '--zimm-color-bg-02': colors.background['02'],
  '--zimm-color-bg-03': colors.background['03'],
  '--zimm-color-bg-04': colors.background['04'],
  '--zimm-color-bg-05': colors.background['05'],
  '--zimm-color-bg-06': colors.background['06'],
  '--zimm-color-bg-07': colors.background['07'],

  // ---- Alias / Semantic: Border ----
  '--zimm-color-border-default': colors.border.default,
  '--zimm-color-border-secondary': colors.border.secondary,
  '--zimm-color-border-focus': colors.border.focus,
  '--zimm-color-border-forms': colors.border.forms,

  // ---- Composite: Focus ring ----
  '--zimm-focus-ring': `${borderWidths.default} solid ${colors.border.focus}`,
  '--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default': focusRingOffsets.default,
  '--zimm-focus-ring-offset-secondary': focusRingOffsets.secondary,

  // ---- Alias / Semantic: Status ----
  '--zimm-color-status-success': colors.status.success,
  '--zimm-color-status-error': colors.status.error,
  '--zimm-color-status-error-bg': colors.status.errorBackground,
  '--zimm-color-status-store-closed': colors.status.storeClosed,

  // ---- Alias / Semantic: Link ----
  '--zimm-color-link-default': colors.link.default,
  '--zimm-color-link-hover': colors.link.hover,

  // ---- Alias / Semantic: Icon ----

  // ---- Alias / Semantic: Action: Primary ----
  '--zimm-color-action-primary-bg-default': colors.action.primary.bgDefault,
  '--zimm-color-action-primary-bg-hover': colors.action.primary.bgHover,
  '--zimm-color-action-primary-bg-pressed': colors.action.primary.bgPressed,
  '--zimm-color-action-primary-bg-disabled': colors.action.primary.bgDisabled,
  '--zimm-color-action-primary-bg-focused': colors.action.primary.bgFocused,
  '--zimm-color-action-primary-text': colors.action.primary.text,
  '--zimm-color-action-primary-text-disabled': colors.action.primary.textDisabled,

  // ---- Alias / Semantic: Action: Secondary ----
  '--zimm-color-action-secondary-border': colors.action.secondary.border,
  '--zimm-color-action-secondary-bg-hover': colors.action.secondary.bgHover,
  '--zimm-color-action-secondary-text': colors.action.secondary.text,
  '--zimm-color-action-secondary-text-inverse': colors.action.secondary.textInverse,
  '--zimm-color-action-secondary-text-disabled': colors.action.secondary.textDisabled,

  // ---- Typography: Font families ----
  // Both heading and body resolve to the same stack, headed by Futura Round.
  // Sourced from ./fonts so the CSS-variable surface and theme.fonts cannot drift
  // apart: text styled by a .zimm-* class and text styled by a Chakra prop must
  // fall back to the same face when Futura Round is unavailable. This intentionally
  // carries the richer fallback stack rather than the Handover's bare

  '--zimm-font-family-body': FONT_REGULAR,
  '--zimm-font-family-serif': FONT_SERIF,

  // ---- Typography: Font sizes ----
  '--zimm-font-size-md': fontSizes.md,
  '--zimm-font-size-xs': fontSizes.xs,
  '--zimm-font-size-2xs': fontSizes['2xs'],
  '--zimm-font-size-3xs': fontSizes['3xs'],
  '--zimm-font-size-4xs': fontSizes['4xs'],

  // ---- Typography: Line heights ----
  '--zimm-font-lineheight-md': lineHeights.md,
  '--zimm-font-lineheight-xs': lineHeights.xs,
  '--zimm-font-lineheight-2xs': lineHeights['2xs'],
  '--zimm-font-lineheight-3xs': lineHeights['3xs'],
  '--zimm-font-lineheight-4xs': lineHeights['4xs'],

  // ---- Typography: Letter spacing ----
  '--zimm-font-letterspacing-sm': letterSpacings.sm,
  '--zimm-font-letterspacing-xs': letterSpacings.xs,
  '--zimm-font-letterspacing-2xs': letterSpacings['2xs'], // -0.14px — see typography.ts
  '--zimm-font-letterspacing-footer': letterSpacings.footer,

  // ---- Typography: Font weights ----
  '--zimm-font-weight-medium': fontWeights.medium,
  '--zimm-font-weight-regular': fontWeights.regular,

  // ---- Spacing scale (named) ----
  '--zimm-scale-3xs': spacing['3xs'],
  '--zimm-scale-2xs': spacing['2xs'],
  '--zimm-scale-xs': spacing.xs,
  '--zimm-scale-s': spacing.s,
  '--zimm-scale-m': spacing.m,
  '--zimm-scale-l': spacing.l,
  '--zimm-scale-xl': spacing.xl,
  '--zimm-scale-2xl': spacing['2xl'],
  '--zimm-scale-3xl': spacing['3xl'],
  '--zimm-scale-4xl': spacing['4xl'],
  '--zimm-scale-5xl': spacing['5xl'],
  '--zimm-scale-6xl': spacing['6xl'],
  '--zimm-scale-7xl': spacing['7xl'],

  // ---- Spacing: numeric aliases ----
  // Ported from the Handover's numeric spacing scale. The ones below that coincide
  // with a named-scale step reference it directly; the rest have no foundation-file
  // source to derive from (not duplicates — genuinely distinct Handover values), so
  // they stay as literals.
  '--zimm-scale-025': '1px',
  '--zimm-scale-200': spacing.xs, // 8px
  '--zimm-scale-300': spacing.s, // 12px
  '--zimm-scale-400': spacing.m, // 16px

  '--zimm-scale-1600': spacing['4xl'], // 64px

  '--zimm-scale-4500': '180px',

  // ---- Spacing: Action sizing ----

  '--zimm-size-action-height-md': actionSizes.height.md,
  '--zimm-size-action-padding-h-lg': actionSizes.paddingX.lg,

  '--zimm-icon-size-lg': iconSizes.lg,

# ZimmColourSwatch (SFCC-91 Step 2/4) — Test Report

Note up front: this environment gave me only `Read` and `Bash` — no sub-agent dispatch tool exists here, so I worked every angle myself sequentially rather than literally fanning out. All commands below were actually executed in this session; outputs are real, not summarized from memory.

---

## 1. Compiles and passes

```
npx tsc --noEmit        → EXIT 0, zero output (matches stated baseline: 0 errors)
npm run lint             → EXIT 1, "20 problems (4 errors, 16 warnings)" — identical to stated
                           pre-existing baseline; the 4 errors are still only at
                           routes.tsx:23,24 and recipeGuards.test.ts:116,335. Nothing in
                           zimmColourSwatch/* appears anywhere in lint output.
npm run test             → EXIT 0, "27 passed (27)" files, "417 passed (417)" tests.
```
The jump from the stated 408→417 (+9, not +8) is explained and confirmed: the new `index.test.tsx` adds 8 tests, and `recipeParts.test.ts` (a `test.each` keyed off every multipart recipe on disk) organically grew by one more generated case now that `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` exists as a second multipart recipe. Ran it standalone with `--reporter=verbose` and confirmed a case literally named `zimmColourSwatch` passed:
```
✓ .../recipeParts.test.ts > multipart recipes declare every part their component reads > zimmColourSwatch
```
CONFIRMED clean, ONE-OFF (nothing to generalize — this angle is fine).

---

## 2. Tokens (`node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`)

```
EXIT 1 — "4 unacknowledged" / "22 acknowledged" — identical to stated baseline, all in
header/index.tsx, header.ts, navConstants.ts. None in this step's files.
```
I didn't just trust the unchanged count — I `git stash -u`'d this step's two changed files and re-ran the audit: **52 files scanned without this step, 54 with it** (exactly +2, matching `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` + `index.tsx`, since `.test.tsx`/`.stories.tsx` are excluded by the script itself). Both new files were genuinely scanned and contributed zero raw-value findings. Stash was popped back cleanly (verified via `git status` + file `md5`).

**However — this angle has a blind spot that matters a lot here (see Angle 3, Finding A).** `audit:tokens` only flags raw hex/px/rem/em literals; it has no concept of validating that a `var(--zimm-*)` string names a real registered variable. A component can reference a completely non-existent token and this script reports it as clean. That's exactly what happened in this step.

---

## 3. Styling conformance

### 🔴 Finding A — `backgroundColor: 'var(--zimm-color-background-02)'` references a CSS custom property that does not exist anywhere in this codebase
`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts:31`

I did not take the recipe's own comment ("Identical across Unselected/Selected/Focus — ivory[200] / background['02']") at face value. I read the **entire** `theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts` (the sole source `ZimmTokensGlobal` uses to emit the `:root` block — confirmed it's the only `<Global>` in the repo touching `--zimm-*`, the other one being unrelated `@font-face` CSS). The registered background aliases are `--zimm-color-bg-01` through `--zimm-color-bg-07` (line 53–59) — **never** `--zimm-color-background-NN`. A repo-wide grep for `zimm-color-background` returns exactly two hits, both inside this new component's own files (the recipe, and its own test asserting the same wrong string back at itself) — nothing else in the codebase uses or defines this name.

I then proved the real-world effect in an actual Chromium instance (Playwright, already installed locally), not jsdom:
```
CONTROL (var(--zimm-color-bg-02), the REAL registered token):        rgb(246, 244, 241)   ← #f6f4f1, real ivory[200]
ACTUAL RECIPE VALUE (var(--zimm-color-background-02), what the       rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)     ← fully transparent
recipe literally uses):
```
This matches the CSS spec exactly: a `var()` referencing an undefined custom property with no fallback makes the whole declaration invalid, which for a non-inherited property like `background-color` resolves to its initial value (`transparent`). **The swatch's background never renders ivory in any real browser — it is always transparent.** The `image` part covers it once the product photo paints (`background-size: cover`), so this is masked whenever the image has already loaded — but not before first paint, not on a slow connection, and not in the one interpretation of the task brief's "Unselected (background only)" state where the background is meant to be a real, visible fill.

This slipped past **every** gate that ran clean above: `tsc` (valid string literal), `eslint` (no such rule), `audit:tokens` (only checks raw literals, not var() validity — confirmed by the stash-differential run), `recipeGuards.test.ts` (only checks *bare* Chakra token keys like `'text.default'` — a `var(...)` string never matches that pattern, confirmed by reading `COLOR_KEYS`'s construction), `recipeParts.test.ts` (unrelated), and — most notably — **the component's own regression-guard test**, which only asserts the resolved value equals the *literal string* `'var(--zimm-color-background-02)'`; jsdom echoes back whatever text is in the declaration whether or not the named variable is real, so the test passes while asserting on a broken value.

🔴 must-fix — **CONFIRMED** (triple-verified: full registry read, full-tree grep, real-Chromium computed-style proof) — **UNIFORM** at the defect-class level: no mechanical check anywhere in this repo validates a `var(--zimm-*)` string against the real token registry, so this exact shape (a plausible-sounding but non-existent token name) could land in any future recipe undetected by anything currently wired up. ONE-OFF as a concrete occurrence today.

### Everything else in the recipe: clean
Read the whole file for any other raw hex/px/rem/em outside comments — none. `aspectRatio: '2 / 3'` and `'solid'` are CSS keywords/ratios, not design values needing tokenization. The `selected: true` branch (`borderBottomWidth`/`Style`/`Color`, lines 36-41) references `var(--zimm-border-width-default)` and `var(--zimm-color-border-focus)` — both **confirmed to exist** in `zimmTokens.ts` (lines 185, 64) and resolve to the correct 1px/grey-900 values. Recipe is correctly namespaced `ZimmColourSwatch` (no base-SFCC collision — the "no recipe silently inherits a base SFCC recipe" guard passed). `parts: ['swatch', 'image']` was independently confirmed to cover every `styles.*` read in `index.tsx` both by direct read and by `recipeParts.test.ts`'s dedicated, passing `zimmColourSwatch` case.

### 🟡 Finding B — pre-existing infrastructure gap, confirmed real: `recipeGuards.test.ts` never fuzzes this recipe's `selected: true` branch
`overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts:217-243`

Read `DEFAULT_STYLE_PROPS` directly: `{inverse, disabled, hasError, focused, filled, theme, colorMode}`. `selected` is not a key. `booleanKeys` (filtered by `typeof === 'boolean'`) is therefore `[inverse, disabled, hasError, focused, filled]` — 5 keys, 32 combinations, none of which ever contains a `selected` key at all. I didn't stop at reading this — I wrote a throwaway probe reproducing the guard's exact `PROP_COMBINATIONS` construction and called `ZimmColourSwatch.baseStyle` with all 32 of them (temp file, deleted immediately after, `git status` confirmed clean before/after):
```
SAW_SELECTED_BRANCH_ACROSS_32_COMBOS: false
SELECTED_KEY_PRESENT_IN_ANY_COMBO: false
DIRECT_CALL_selected_true_HAS_borderBottomWidth: true   ← branch exists and works when called directly
```
This matches exactly what the task brief predicted a prior check had found. Per the task's own framing this is a **pre-existing** gap in a Tier 2 shared test file, not something to blame on this step's code — this step is simply the first recipe with a `selected`-keyed branch, so the first actually affected. I separately, manually confirmed (not relying on the guard) that the `selected: true` branch itself is token-clean — see above. **These are two independent findings**: the fuzzing gap would not have caught Finding A even if it did walk `selected: true`, because `recipeGuards.test.ts` checks for bare Chakra keys, never `var()` name validity — an entirely different failure class.

🟡 should-fix (test-infra, not this step's file) — **CONFIRMED** via direct empirical probe, not just reading — **UNIFORM** (this will silently under-test every future recipe with a boolean prop outside the tracked set, not just this one).

### 🔵 Note — mutation-test claim reproduced, but its own inline comment mispredicts the failure value
`index.test.tsx:106-111`

I did exactly what the task asked: temporarily reinserted `backgroundColor={name.toLowerCase()}` into the actual `chakra.span` branch of `index.tsx` (the branch the regression test actually renders by default, since no `href` is passed), re-ran the one test, reverted from a backup, re-ran again. Real before/after output:
```
BEFORE (mutated):  FAIL — AssertionError: expected 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' to be 'var(--zimm-color-background-02)'
AFTER (reverted):  PASS — all 8 tests green again (md5 of index.tsx matched pre-mutation exactly)
```
The guard is real and works. But its own comment predicts the mutation "would read the literal 'bay blue' instead" — the actual observed value is `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)`, because `"bay blue"` is a two-word string and therefore an invalid CSS colour keyword; the browser/jsdom rejects the whole declaration rather than echoing the literal text. Doesn't undermine the guard (it still fails correctly), just a comment-accuracy nit. 🔵 note — CONFIRMED, ONE-OFF.

---

## 4. Structure — clean

Named export `ZimmColourSwatch` matches folder `zimmColourSwatch/` (consistent with sibling atoms). Props type `ZimmColourSwatchProps` matches convention. Story present at `Commerce/ZimmColourSwatch` with three meaningfully-distinct named exports (`Default`, `Selected`, `WithoutLink`) — not over-covered. Own `index.test.tsx` with 8 real-logic tests. No data-fetching hook anywhere — purely presentational, receives everything as props (confirmed by full read). `theme/components/index.ts` diff independently re-confirmed as **exactly 2 insertions, 0 deletions, 1 file** via `git diff --stat`, matching the task's stated expectation precisely.

---

## 5. Imports — clean

`index.tsx` has **zero relative imports** — the recipe is consumed by its registered string key (`useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_COLOUR_SWATCH_RECIPE, ...)`), not a direct file import, so there's no `../../../..` chain to even evaluate. `theme/components/index.ts` registers it via the same `app/...` absolute-alias convention every sibling entry uses. Repo-wide grep confirms **nothing outside this atom's own folder imports it yet** except the theme registration — correctly unwired at Step 2/4, no premature molecule/page coupling, no leak of a later-sprint concern. Grepped this step's files for "size"/"order"/"position" specifically to check for a Step 3/4 ordering leak — the only hits are `size=Large/Rectangle` (a Figma frame-variant name in a comment) and unrelated tab-order prose; no leak. `ColourSwatchLink = chakra(RouteLink)` is declared at module scope (`index.tsx:11`, top-level) — confirmed not recreated per-render.
